record.question: Despite all the complaints, we must admit that his behavior with others has always courteous.
record.explanation: Answer B: has always been courteous. The adjective “courteous” needs the linking verb “been” after “has always.” Independent check: The present-perfect construction requires “has always been courteous.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/present-perfect-simple-i-have-worked.
